description.value:
You can use your body to great effect to throw your enemies away or off-balance, empowering your wings to push them away or your tail to knock them down. When you use this feat, you target creatures in a 15-foot cone away from you with either a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell] save or a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save (your choice) against your spell DC or class DC, whichever is greater. A creature who fails a save becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} for 1 round. In addition, if you choose Reflex, a target is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} on a critical failure. If you choose Fortitude, a target is shoved away 5 feet on a failure, or 10 feet on a critical failure.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.ancestries.evAxFVUdmJhPL3UG]{Draconic Arms} feat for a Wing (Fortitude) or a Tail (Reflex) unarmed attack, you also deal damage to an affected creature as if you hit with these weapons, using the save outcome as if it was a basic saving throw.
